scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec api npm run migrate -w @blackbox/api
scripts.seed: docker compose exec api npm run seed -w @blackbox/api
scripts.psql: docker compose exec db psql -U blackbox -d blackbox
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @blackbox/api && npm run typecheck -w @blackbox/web
